{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Tn9MGayA9aixV14J7qB8Sx","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t// ARIA's own rule configuration for `lint-rules-adapter` (ARIA-MEDIUM-178).\n2\t//\n3\t// This is NOT the repository's developer lint (`eslint.config.mjs`): that\n4\t// one gates commits and must stay quiet. This one is the adapter's scan\n5\t// surface — every rule of the two curated packs, run in shadow, so the\n6\t// findings reach ARIA's ledger, its judges and its label queue, and the\n7\t// packs are pruned by this repository's own labels (rule by rule: a\n8\t// false-positive share above the policy floor retires a rule; below the\n9\t// ceiling promotes it) before any of it is asked of a developer.\n10\t//\n11\t// The packs are the open-source implementations of SonarSource's JS/TS\n12\t// rules (`eslint-plugin-sonarjs`, LGPL, run as a plugin and never copied)\n13\t// and `eslint-plugin-security`. No type information is given to the\n14\t// parser on purpose: type-aware rules need a `parserOptions.project` per\n15\t// workspace and multiply the scan time; the first shadow measurement is of\n16\t// the syntactic packs, and the type-aware tier is a later, measured step.\n17\timport tsParser from '@typescript-eslint/parser';\n18\timport security from 'eslint-plugin-security';\n19\timport sonarjs from 'eslint-plugin-sonarjs';\n20\t\n21\texport default [\n22\t  {\n23\t    ignores: [\n24\t      '**/node_modules/**',\n25\t      '**/dist/**',\n26\t      '**/build/**',\n27\t      '**/coverage/**',\n28\t      '**/.archive/**',\n29\t      '**/*.d.ts',\n30\t    ],\n31\t  },\n32\t  {\n33\t    // The developer lint's inline suppression comments are not this\n34\t    // configuration's business: one written for a repository rule would\n35\t    // otherwise come back as an unused-directive notice from a scan that\n36\t    // never ran that rule.\n37\t    linterOptions: { reportUnusedDisableDirectives: 'off' },\n38\t  },\n39\t  {\n40\t    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],\n41\t    languageOptions: {\n42\t      parser: tsParser,\n43\t      parserOptions: { ecmaVersion: 'latest', sourceType: 'module', ecmaFeatures: { jsx: true } },\n44\t    },\n45\t  },\n46\t  sonarjs.configs.recommended,\n47\t  security.configs.recommended,\n48\t];\n49\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a1fa066d-8164-4220-b63b-5fcf1c7f9d7c","uuid":"227623e4-9135-4d38-89ee-d2ed1b3d95a0","timestamp":"2026-10-05T05:28:30.354Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-7a3147429c6b/tools/aria-adapters/lint-rules.eslint.config.mjs","content":"// ARIA's own rule configuration for `lint-rules-adapter` (ARIA-MEDIUM-178).\n//\n// This is NOT the repository's developer lint (`eslint.config.mjs`): that\n// one gates commits and must stay quiet. This one is the adapter's scan\n// surface — every rule of the two curated packs, run in shadow, so the\n// findings reach ARIA's ledger, its judges and its label queue, and the\n// packs are pruned by this repository's own labels (rule by rule: a\n// false-positive share above the policy floor retires a rule; below the\n// ceiling promotes it) before any of it is asked of a developer.\n//\n// The packs are the open-source implementations of SonarSource's JS/TS\n// rules (`eslint-plugin-sonarjs`, LGPL, run as a plugin and never copied)\n// and `eslint-plugin-security`. No type information is given to the\n// parser on purpose: type-aware rules need a `parserOptions.project` per\n// workspace and multiply the scan time; the first shadow measurement is of\n// the syntactic packs, and the type-aware tier is a later, measured step.\nimport tsParser from '@typescript-eslint/parser';\nimport security from 'eslint-plugin-security';\nimport sonarjs from 'eslint-plugin-sonarjs';\n\nexport default [\n  {\n    ignores: [\n      '**/node_modules/**',\n      '**/dist/**',\n      '**/build/**',\n      '**/coverage/**',\n      '**/.archive/**',\n      '**/*.d.ts',\n    ],\n  },\n  {\n    // The developer lint's inline suppression comments are not this\n    // configuration's business: one written for a repository rule would\n    // otherwise come back as an unused-directive notice from a scan that\n    // never ran that rule.\n    linterOptions: { reportUnusedDisableDirectives: 'off' },\n  },\n  {\n    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],\n    languageOptions: {\n      parser: tsParser,\n      parserOptions: { ecmaVersion: 'latest', sourceType: 'module', ecmaFeatures: { jsx: true } },\n    },\n  },\n  sonarjs.configs.recommended,\n  security.configs.recommended,\n];\n","numLines":49,"startLine":1,"totalLines":49}}}
